overview: The council debated a $165,000 public works appropriation for infrastructure repairs, which was ultimately tabled for further review. Members also moved to address the regulation of short-term rentals and requested a meeting with the city's parking contractor regarding recent ownership changes.

items.title: Law Department Settlement and DPW Appropriation
items.summary: Approved a $5,000 slip-and-fall settlement but tabled a $165,000 appropriation request for catch basins, sidewalks, and trees to allow for further discussion on city-wide maintenance strategy and staffing.

items.title: Liquor Licensing and Business Permits
items.summary: Referred a Home Rule petition to increase wine and malt beverage licenses to subcommittee and approved an hours extension for Boston Wings (Wingstop) and a license for Batia’s Place.

items.title: State Election Call and Parking Contract Update
items.summary: Designated polling locations for the November 8th election and requested a meeting with the new owners of Republic Parking to discuss contract amendments and senior parking policies.

items.title: Ceremonial Business, Airbnb Oversight, and MBTA Signage
items.summary: Congratulated local class officers, honored the late Thomas E. English, referred the oversight of Airbnbs to subcommittee, and requested the MBTA relocate a displaced bus stop sign.

items.title: Community Announcements
items.summary: Received announcements regarding upcoming veterans' events and a schedule for neighborhood community policing meetings.
